Core Crafting Mechanics (Kibbles' Crafting Guide)

Kibbles' crafting system allows adventurers to produce mundane and magical items in a balanced, dynamic, and engaging way.

Crafting Check

Every 2 hours of work produces one crafting check; a success adds 2 hours of progress.

Source Pages: 5, 6

Failure

A failed check produces no progress. Three consecutive failures lose the reserved materials and all progress.

Source Pages: 6, 43

Take 10

Taking 10 doubles each check to 4 hours and uses 10 + related ability modifier + tool proficiency bonus as the result.

Source Pages: 5, 7

Workday Limit

A full workday normally contributes no more than 8 hours to a crafting project.

Source Pages: 7

Rest Crafting

During a long rest, the craft camp action can contribute up to 2 hours if the character does nothing else besides crafting and sleeping; perception is impaired while doing so.

Source Pages: 6

Tool Requirement

Attempting a branch without its applicable tool is normally impossible; improvised tools are a GM option and use disadvantage.

Source Pages: 6

Heat And Infrastructure

Some branches require a heat source or additional workshop infrastructure at the GM's discretion; blacksmithing new items requires a forge and anvil.

Source Pages: 6

Roll Bonuses

Crafting checks do not receive temporary external bonuses by default; expertise is included, and full-duration help from a proficient crafter is the principal exception described by the book.

Source Pages: 5, 7

Material Trade

Buying materials normally uses listed value; selling to an interested buyer usually yields half value, subject to the GM and the market.

Source Pages: 7

Reagent Interchangeability

Curative, reactive, and poisonous reagents are interchangeable within their labeled type and rarity; they cannot be salvaged after being combined into another form.

Source Pages: 8

Essence Synthesis

Three same-rarity reagents can be synthesized into one essence: arcane uses one curative, one poisonous, and one reactive; primal uses three reactive; divine uses two curative and one reactive.

Source Pages: 8

Essence Salvage

A permanent magic item can return one essence of its rarity after a 2-hour salvage process; the item becomes nonmagical and attunement prevents the process.

Source Pages: 8

Ink And Ingot

Magical ink is a crafting material with a listed weight of about 0.1 lb; standard steel ingots are treated as 2 lb and 2 gp each in the material rules.

Source Pages: 8, 9

Labor Formula

The appendix uses rarity, difficulty, time, labor cost, and a risk multiplier as the variables for designing new item recipes; the book presents ranges rather than a universal import formula.

Source Pages: 95

Alchemy, Potions & Special Modifiers

Alchemy allows producing healing draughts, poisons, and throwable flasks with special enhancements:

ModifierDC IncreaseExtra MaterialsSpecial Effect
Aerosol+82 extra Reactive Reagents of equal rarityCan be broken or uncorked as an action to affect all creatures within a 5-foot radius.
Concentrated+51 extra Curative or Poisonous ReagentNumerical healing or damage dice are maximized.
Long Lasting+41 extra Reactive ReagentThe duration of temporary potion effects is doubled.

Blacksmithing, Alloys & Custom Modifications

Weapons and armors can be forged using superior metals or customized with special properties:

Material / ModifierDC AdjustWeapon PropertiesArmor Properties
Adamantine+5Critical hits against objects and structures are automatic.Converts incoming critical hits into normal hits.
Mithral+4Removes Heavy property or adds Finesse.Removes Stealth disadvantage and Strength requirements.
Silvered+2Overcomes non-magical damage immunities of lycanthropes and fiends.Deals 1d4 radiant damage to creatures grappling the wearer.
Aerodynamic+4Gains Thrown (10/30) or extends thrown range by 10/30 ft.Stabilized fast falling speed.
Serrated+3Critical hits cause 1d6 ongoing bleed damage per round.—
